To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a mission-profile-dependent reliability prediction model for HEV powertrain is proposed, and the proposed control schemes can improve reliability of powertrain.

1) the reliability of power electronics is a function of driving scenarios; 2) the reliability of the powertrain is a function of the power electronics reliability; 3) the power electronics reliability can be improved by reducing the thermal stresses and electrical stresses; and 4) variable dc-link and hybrid discontinuous pulse width modulation schemes can be applied to improve the power electronics reliability.
the reliability of HEV power electronic system can be enhanced by using variable dc-link voltage and hybrid discontinuous pulse width modulation control strategies.

reliability assessment and enhancement for HEVs, which will provide an important reference for HEV design and control.
the reliability assessment of HEVs and the design of control strategies to improve the reliability of HEV power electronics.
the reliability assessment of the HEV drivetrain and the improvement of system reliability by proposing two control strategies.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a mission profile-based reliability model to assess the reliability of HEVs, which takes into consideration the driving conditions, dormant mode, and electrical and thermal stresses of the powertrain.

this paper presents a new methodology to evaluate the reliability of power electronic systems in HEVs, and it also provides two novel control strategies to improve the reliability of HEV power electronic systems.
the proposed methodology can provide a quantitative assessment of system reliability and can be used to improve the reliability and efficiency of the overall system.

the proposed reliability analysis methodology can be used to evaluate the system reliability of different HEV powertrain configurations and topologies, and the proposed control schemes can be applied to HEVs to increase their reliability.
